cases.name: God-Pharaoh's Gift
cases.text: At the beginning of combat on your turn, you may exile a creature card from your graveyard. If you do, create a token that's a copy of that card, except it's a 4/4 black Zombie. It gains haste until end of turn.

cases.name: Example Relic
